  • Method Details

    • authenticate

      public Optional<User> authenticate(String email, String password) throws AuthenticationException
      Description copied from interface: IUserService
      Authenticates a user with email and password credentials.

      This method verifies the provided credentials against stored user data. It only considers active, non-deleted users for authentication. Password verification uses BCrypt hashing for security.

      Specified by:
      authenticate in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      email - the user's email address
      password - the plain text password to verify
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the authenticated user if successful
      Throws:
      AuthenticationException - if the credentials are invalid or user not found

    • register

      public void register(String name, String email, String password, String phone) throws ValidationException, UserAlreadyExistsException
      Description copied from interface: IUserService
      Registers a new user in the system.

      This method validates the input data, ensures the email is unique, and creates a new user account with default permissions. The password is automatically hashed before storage.

      Specified by:
      register in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      name - the full name of the user, must not be empty or contain only digits
      email - the email address, must be valid format and unique
      password - the plain text password, must meet complexity requirements
      phone - the phone number, must contain only digits
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if any input validation fails
      UserAlreadyExistsException - if a user with the email already exists

    • adminRegister

      public void adminRegister(String name, String email, String password, String phone, String role, String accessLevel) throws ValidationException, UserAlreadyExistsException, UserNotFoundException
      Description copied from interface: IUserService
      Registers a new user with administrative privileges.

      This method is used by administrators to create user accounts with specific roles and access levels. It performs the same validation as regular registration but allows setting administrative properties.

      Specified by:
      adminRegister in interface IUserService
      Parameters:
      name - the full name of the user
      email - the email address, must be unique
      password - the plain text password
      phone - the phone number
      role - the user role (USER, ADMIN)
      accessLevel - the access level (READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE, MANAGE)
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if any input validation fails
      UserAlreadyExistsException - if a user with the email already exists
      UserNotFoundException - if the created user cannot be found for role assignment
